_comment: Occasions = any event the platform runs. 'main' is the one the home page follows. type 'awards' = main OGA; type 'special' = side events (e.g. Miss OGITECH). Special occasions appear on the home page only when enabled:true AND link.href is set. mode 'auto' derives the home state from timeline dates; 'manual' uses forceState.
